item.coloph: mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar mas/ nges med sprang po drung mu wer ro la/ gyim shod shel brag tu/ dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes bco lnga la snyan du brgyud/ mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa dang / dad ldan grogs po'i (pos) bskul ba'i ngor/ zal (zab) mo dben pa'i ri khrod du/ dkar chag yi ger bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge bas 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shogag bon 'di zab rgyas nyi ma'i zer bzhin shog/
